```

     Space/KeyW/KeyX/KeyZ->jump  (KeyZ = run AND jump, like NES B). Enter->start.
p1 exposes `keys` and a boolean `enterPressed` consumed (and cleared) by p9.
Prevent default for arrows/space.

grid = 2D array [row][col] of TILE codes, built by buildLevel() (called in p9 boot and on level reset).
blockContent = {}  // key "col,row" -> content: "coin"|"mushroom"|"flower"|"star"|"multi"|"1up" ; default coin
decor        = []  // {type:"hill"|"bush"|"cloud", x: col, y: row} — p5 draws procedurally (rects/arcs), no tiles.

| `onGesture` | p15 | p16 first user pointer/key event | `()` — unlock audio, create AudioContext |
| `onEnd` | p15 (jingle), p13 (overlay) | p16 `checkWin()` | `(status)` `'victory'\|'defeat'` |
| `panelClick` | p13 | p12 (panel-region click) | `(btnId)` → void; no-op ⇒ click ignored |
| `placementClick` | p13 | p12 (click in view while placing) | `(tx,ty)` → bool handled |
| `uiKey` | p13 | p12 (KEYMAP action `cmd:*`,`build:*`,`train:*`,`cancel`,`mute`,`pause`) | `(action)` → void |
| `mute` | p15 | p13 (`M` key) | `()` — toggles mute |
`team ∈ {0,1}`, `tx,ty` = tile ints, `id` = entity id, `kind` = string key of `UNITS`/`BUILDINGS`.

| `Input.enqueue(evt)` | void | `evt = {type:'pointer', kind:'down'\|'up'\|'move', btn:0\|2, shift, cx, cy}` \| `{type:'key', code, down}` \| `{type:'wheel'}`; pushes to `RT.inputQueue` |
| `Input.flush()` | void | drains queue in order (called by p16 at tick start); routes by `regionAt`: `view` ⇒ world commands (p6/p8) after the placement hook check, `panel` ⇒ `callHook('panelClick', hitTestPanel-later)`, `minimap` ⇒ camera only, `top`/`info`/`out` ⇒ ignored. Keys: camera keys handled here; all other `KEYMAP` actions ⇒ `callHook('uiKey', action)` |
| `Input.update()` | void | camera scroll from held keys + screen edges (in ticks) |
